name: Typesense
description: Runs typo-tolerant search with built-in vector, hybrid, and semantic modes over a REST API, self-hosted or on Typesense Cloud.

skills.name: Hybrid Search
skills.description: Blends keyword and vector scoring in one query so agents retrieve on both exact terms and semantic similarity.

skills.name: Vector Indexing
skills.description: Indexes embeddings alongside structured document fields, with automatic embedding generation for supported models.

skills.name: Faceted Filtering
skills.description: Filters and facets results by structured attributes to narrow agent retrieval to a relevant document subset.
